bugs.title: --section-bottom-padding is set to "undefined" in theme config (coachnew.fynd.io)
bugs.description:
The CSS variable --section-bottom-padding has a literal value of "undefined" instead of a valid CSS value (e.g. "16px", "#fff"). This usually means the theme configuration is missing this value.

Visual impact: Low — browser is using a fallback value, so the UI may appear normal despite the config error
Raw value in HTML: undefinedpx
Computed (browser fallback): undefinedpx

How to verify:
1. Open coachnew.fynd.io in your browser
2. Right-click → Inspect → Elements tab
3. Select the <html> element and check Computed Styles
4. Search for "--section-bottom-padding" — you will see it is set to "undefined"
5. Check if the affected area (e.g. section bottom padding) looks visually correct despite the bad value
bugs.fix: Set --section-bottom-padding to a valid value in the theme configuration (e.g. "16px" or "0px")
